what_happened: Four Teichner searches were running with 24 h (86400 s) budgets when the container was reclaimed and replaced. Every one died mid-search having completed zero partner runs. The scratchpad and the git history survived; the in-flight compute did not.
operational_rule: The observed container lifetime was about 26 h. A 24 h budget therefore does not fit inside one container once startup and the first hours of other work are counted. Budget long searches at 20 h (72000 s) or less, and prefer a box that finishes to a box that is merely larger.
what_saved_the_records: The heartbeat in teichner_certify.py. Each dead run still names its knot, partner, sum crossing number and start time, so the attempt is documented rather than silently absent. Earlier kills on the pre-heartbeat build left nothing at all.
toolchain_note: The rebuilt container keeps the Sage-backed toolchain; the K_B calibration reproduces (unknot found, certificate verified). Its first timing reads 2.96 s, which is cold-start only: repeated runs settle at 0.52-0.71 s, against 0.87 s on the previous container. Do not re-budget from a cold first measurement.
